articles.summary: WEST ORANGE, N.J., Feb. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BEL FUSE INC. articles.title: Bel Fuse Inc. Announces Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend on its Class A and Class B Shares
